additionalInformation: Несколько Damage Return от Blade Mail не складываются.
Полностью сочетается с другими источниками урона с меткой «неотражаемый».
description: Острый, как лезвие бритвы, панцирь — выбор самоотверженных мучеников.
recommendedFor: If taking Counter Helix damage was not enough of a punishment for attacking the Axe, then Blade Mail will make sane people cry. Few heroes can take damage from both abilities early on, and Blade Mail continues to be lethal in the late game, unlike Counter Helix which scales off
A highly durable hero, his namesake Bristleback helps him last longer in teamfights. Combined with Blade Mail, this provides him a significant increase in both offense and defense

Similar to Axe and Legion Commander, Clockwerk can stop heroes from running away from him and forces out engagements while continuously barraging the enemy with Battery Assault. Having Blade Mail makes it so much worse for them as Clockwerk's high health pool makes it very unlikely that he will die first
Clockwerk also benefits from all the stats Blade Mail provides
Pairs really well with Natural Order
Elder Titan loves to be in the middle of the fight
She can heal up quickly and will slow any direct attacker thanks to her passive, forcing anyone to cast strong spells on her to deal significant damage only to get it reflected back at them
Duel forces enemies to engage Legion Commander head-on and attack her without pause, maximizing Blade Mail's efficiency if she is using it
Having a natural heal ability Death Pulse, he can slip away and heal in the process easily
Already having a damage reflect ability Dispersion Spectre ensures no one touches her as long as blade barrier is active
Enduring tons of damage Wraith King can have breathing space

notes: Урон возвращается в изначальном количестве, до его уменьшения.
Возвращаемый урон имеет тот же тип, что и полученный.
Урон от заклинаний этого предмета считается отражённым. Его нельзя отразить вновь, и от него не срабатывает вампиризм.
abilities.description: Увеличивает долю возвращаемого урона на 85% и делает так, что владелец отражает любой получаемый урон. Длится 5.5 сек.
Возвращает 10 + 15% урона от каждой атаки атакующим вас существам.

name: Blade Mail
